descriptionChirho: The ordinal number 'fourth,' used attributively or predicatively to indicate position in a sequence (fourth day, fourth river, fourth generation, etc.), across all grammatical forms including with article, conjunction, and preposition prefixes.
A fractional quantity meaning 'one-quarter' or 'a fourth part of' something, used in construct or absolute state to denote a measured portion (a fourth of a hin, a fourth of a shekel, etc.).
Describes a shape as being square or foursquare, i.e., having four equal sides, used of architectural measurements (the court was square).
